title: Is there AI to auto rig and animate in one click quadrupeds ?
author: raaaaapl
selftext:
Is there AI to auto rig and animate in one click quadrupeds ?

on tripo / meshy there only one walking animation, thats useless

comments.author: GaiusVictor
comments.body: Wait, is there an AI to autorig (I'm not even asking for animation!) bipeds?

replies.author: Ponacko
replies.body: It's not AI in the current sense, but autorig for bipeds has existed for a while, Mixamo

replies.author: GaiusVictor
replies.body: Thank you, I know about Mixamo but failed to register OP had mentioned Meshy and was thinking about 2D models.

comments.author: DragonfruitDecent862
comments.body: Autorig? Rigging is easy, mapping animations to  "new rig" without warp is not. You can rig anything in seconds on ACCURIG. Not trying to sound like a promoter lol. And its free also. I have a custom game engine ive made, and needed custom rigs made for humanoid characters. Check out accurig.

replies.author: raaaaapl
replies.body: i use it but i want for animals

replies.author: DragonfruitDecent862
replies.body: ..rigging is quite easy. Your issue is the animations. Those are rare. Your best bet is a asset pack off of unity store, or itch.io

replies.author: raaaaapl
replies.body: its too hard for rigging in this version and doesnt work correctly

comments.author: Pretend-Park6473
comments.body: slice it into two bipeds and animate each one
